mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `document` (kb_id, user_id, name, type, size, status, file_path) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{size}, #{status}, #{filePath})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.kb_id, d.name, d.type, d.size, d.status, d.error_msg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc_chunk c WHERE c.document_id = d.id) AS chunk_count, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.created_at) * 1000 AS UNSIGNED) AS created_at FROM `document` d WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.created_at DESC

SELECT d.id, d.kb_id, d.name, d.type, d.size, d.status, d.error_msg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc_chunk c WHERE c.document_id = d.id) AS chunk_count, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.created_at) * 1000 AS UNSIGNED) AS created_at FROM `document` d WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM `document` WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
